##### Get taxonomy of a set of genes using DIAMOND and MEGAN #####

# Run DIAMOND on the set of selected genes against NCBI nr database

diamond_09_30 blastp -d /mnt/data/NCBI/NR/nr -q sample.faa -o sample.daa -f 100


#Get the final taxonomy using MEGAN
# Run meganizer on the .daa file generated by DIAMOND and the MEGAN database

/Applications/MEGAN/tools/daa-meganizer -i sample.daa -mdb megan-map-Jan2021.db

#Open the .daa file with MEGAN and set the lower common ancestor parameters to the desired setting (e.g. minimum e-value of 1x10E-20 and top percent of 1%)

#Export the result as .csv file using "readName_to_taxonPath" option
